title_vi: Chín việc làm khi phát triển dịch vụ nhỏ: việc nào có chỗ đối chiếu

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body read from a git fetch of the pinned commit and hashed as a Git blob; computed OID matches the source map. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

claims.evidence: Microsoft's microservices architecture style page (Best practices) and the Twelve-Factor App pages Processes, Build-release-run and Codebase read from local clones; session placement measured with three Python web servers, Redis 7.0.15 and 301 users, three runs. Three of the nine practices (container, micro frontend, similar maturity) have no direct counterpart in the pages read and are labelled unchecked.

mobile.evidence: Figure drawn by scripts/figures (viewBox width 320, smallest font 15 px, shown at 13.5 px at 320 px); python3 -m scripts.figures check --browser passed; the lesson (Markdown to HTML, optional sections open, 16 px side gutters) rendered in Chromium at 320, 375 and 430 px with no horizontal overflow of the page, any table or any code block. Not learner testing and not GitHub or a real phone.

claims.claim_vi: Microsoft best practices: model services around the business domain with DDD and avoid overly granular services; data storage private to the service that owns it; avoid coupling such as shared database schemas; loose coupling and high functional cohesion; deploy services independently with CI/CD; a management/orchestration component schedules and deploys services across nodes.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036.

claims.claim_vi: Twelve-factor processes are stateless and share-nothing, persistent data lives in a stateful backing service, and sticky sessions (session data cached in the process memory) are not to be relied upon; the app uses strict separation between build, release and run stages; one codebase per app, many deploys.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of heroku/12factor at commit 1385d2c80bac38c25647651f6f5ec769561828dc.

claims.claim_vi: Three web server instances behind client-side round robin, 301 users with one login and five further requests each: with sessions in each instance's memory 301 of 1,505 requests (20.0 %) had a valid session, median 238-330 us, and after one instance was shut down 200 of 301 users had no session; with sessions in Redis 1,505 of 1,505 (100 %), median 344-396 us, 0 of 301 lost.
claims.verified_by: Experiment run by the author on 2026-10-19 (three runs; 20.0 % follows from 301 users, 3 instances and round robin).

claims.claim_vi: Nine best practices listed by the source: separate data storage per microservice, code at a similar level of maturity, separate build per microservice, single responsibility per microservice, deploy into containers, stateless services, adopt domain-driven design, design micro frontend, orchestrating microservices.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit; the source gives titles only.

design_notes_vi: Ba khung ghi chú chia chín việc thành ba nhóm và một khung kết quả đo. Bảng đối chiếu nằm trong bài.
source_deviations: The source lists nine titles with no explanation; the lesson groups them, maps six to independent documents, labels three as unchecked and measures one.
The lesson adds a session-placement experiment that the source does not contain.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết tại repo này (gói W8), giữ ở trạng thái draft chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
